fix_instructions: No individual check (C1–C7, P1) needs wording or threshold fixes since all passed in all rollouts. The scenario itself needs structural revision to create genuine inter-agent dependency: (1) introduce cross-agent information needs so that one agent's fact changes what another must reveal or how they must act — e.g., make PF3's 9:20 PM timing conflict with the volunteer rehearsal window from PF2, forcing A3 and A4 to negotiate; (2) add ambiguity or competing constraints in shared_context so that A1 cannot simply settle after a round-robin — e.g., give A1 a default assumption that contradicts one fact, requiring the fact-holder to actively correct it; (3) consider adding a distractor fact or a false lead so that not every reveal is automatically the correct answer, testing whether agents can distinguish relevant from irrelevant information. The goal is to produce rollouts where some fail (facts not surfaced, wrong decisions made) unless agents genuinely engage with each other's information, proving the scenario requires multi-agent coordination rather than sequential reporting.
